change.summary: Added a subtle mouse-following radial light over the authored SANCI hero key art. It is an aria-hidden decorative layer, only initialized for fine hover pointers, ignores touch events, follows the hero bounds, fades on pointer leave, and removes its listeners/layer during rerender or disable. Reduced-motion visitors and browsers without fine-pointer media support keep the unchanged authored artwork. No Page Model content, Save, Publish, D1 schema/data, R2 object, or third-party dependency changed.
change.inspiration: Uses a broadly familiar interactive light treatment from modern gaming/creator design, implemented with SANCI's own palette and existing editor-authored image; no reference code, logo, media, copy, or graphics were copied.
